title: mimi-server: accept /notify for a room only from its hub
description: parse_fanout_messages/store_fanout (JMAP-6k5d.6) take room_id and hub_uri from the caller and store for any authenticated hub. draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 §5.5 has the hub fan out to followers; a follower should refuse a /notify for a room whose hub is a different provider, or any authenticated provider can inject Messages into any room's bound Chats. Needs a decision on where a follower learns a room's hub (room_uri authority, the Welcome's GroupContext, or a stored room record) before a check can be written.
notes:
Mark 2026-10-21: option A. Hub = provider named by the room ID's authority (mimi://<authority>/r/...). Library check (e.g. a notify_from_hub(room_id, hub_uri) helper / store_fanout precondition, trait docs) rejects /notify whose authenticated sender authority differs. Spec sentence in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §application/mimi-fanout (landed with this decision). Upstream MIMI issue/PR tracked in mimid.
Spec landed: jmap-chat-spec 29e9a41 (mimi-00 §application/mimi-fanout hub rule).
